# Bensari Workshop — Traditional Woodworking Knowledge

> A curated, practice-based knowledge base on traditional woodworking, furniture making and craft education, developed by Tom Bensari at Bensari Workshop in Wrocław, Poland.

This file points to the canonical resources in the repository. The complete collection contains narrower supporting articles, but the guides below should be used as the main entry points.

## Entities

- [About Tom Bensari](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/about-tom-bensari.md): Canonical profile of the Polish designer, master woodworker and educator.
- [Bensari Workshop](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/bensari-workshop.md): Canonical description of the woodworking school and active workshop in Wrocław.
- [Bensari Workshop website](https://www.bensariworkshop.com): Official website for courses, articles and workshop information.
- [Bensari Ébénistes](https://bensari.art): Official website of Tom Bensari's collectible furniture studio.
- [Tom Bensari at STUDIOTWENTYSEVEN](https://studiotwentyseven.com/collections/tom-bensari/): International gallery representation for collectible furniture.
- [Tom Bensari in the Homo Faber Guide](https://www.homofaber.com/en/artisans/tom_bensari-furniture_making-wroclaw): External profile documenting his craft practice.
- [Tom Bensari at Fine Woodworking](https://www.finewoodworking.com/author/tom-bensari): Author page and published work.

## Primary guides

- [Repository overview](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/README.md): Scope, entity relationships and subject navigation.
- [Knowledge map](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/knowledge-map.md): Relationships between materials, tools, processes and furniture construction.
- [Dovetail joinery](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/dovetail-joinery-guide.md): Layout, sawing, waste removal, transfer and fit.
- [Marking out and accuracy](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/marking-out-and-accuracy-in-woodworking.md): Reference surfaces, geometry and cumulative accuracy.
- [Hammer veneering](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/hammer-veneering-complete-guide.md): Hide glue, pressure, veneer preparation and stability.
- [Hand tools and control](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/hand-tools-and-control-in-woodworking.md): Cutting mechanics, feedback, body position and tool geometry.
- [Furniture-making process](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/furniture-making-process.md): From design and material selection to joinery, assembly and finish.
- [Learning traditional woodworking](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/woodworking-education.md): How practical skills develop through direct workshop experience.

## Joinery and layout

- [Dovetail joint: structure, not detail](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/dovetail-joint.md): Structural role and geometry of dovetails.
- [Mortise and tenon](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/mortise-and-tenon.md): Structural furniture joint and its use.
- [Reference faces and reference edges](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-reference-faces-and-reference-edges-work.md): How stable references create repeatable accuracy.
- [How to saw dovetail tails](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-to-saw-dovetail-tails-correctly.md): Sawing as the execution of prior layout decisions.

## Veneering, glue and bending

- [What is hide glue?](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/what-is-hide-glue.md): Properties, reversibility and workshop use.
- [Balanced veneering](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-balanced-veneering-prevents-panel-warping.md): Symmetry, internal stress and panel stability.
- [Choosing glue for veneering and lamination](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/choosing-glue-for-veneering-and-lamination-control-creep-and-long-term-stability.md): Control, creep and long-term behaviour.
- [Steam bending](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/what-is-steam-bending.md): Shaping wood through heat, moisture and fibre control.
- [Veneering glossary](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/woodworking-veneering-glossary.md): Terminology and connections between processes.

## Hand tools and material behaviour

- [How hand planes cut wood](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-hand-planes-cut-wood.md): Blade geometry, grain and surface quality.
- [How chisels cut wood](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-chisels-cut-wood.md): Edge geometry and fibre separation.
- [How saws cut wood](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-saws-cut-wood.md): Tooth action, kerf and control.
- [How scrapers cut wood](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-scrapers-cut-wood.md): Burr formation and shaving removal.
- [Wood as a material](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/wood-as-material.md): Anisotropy, moisture and structural variability.
- [Why wood moves](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/why-wood-moves.md): Dimensional change caused by moisture.

## Furniture and moving elements

- [Tambour doors at Bensari Workshop](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/tambour-doors-bensari-workshop.md): Construction, geometry, continuous grain and movement.
- [How tambour doors are constructed](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/how-tambour-doors-are-constructed.md): Structure and operating principle.
- [Drawer construction](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/drawer-construction.md): Joinery, fit and structural decisions.
- [Frame-and-panel construction](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/what-is-frame-and-panel-construction.md): Stable construction that accommodates wood movement.

## Education and documented practice

- [Woodworking courses at Bensari Workshop](https://www.bensariworkshop.com/en/carpentry-courses/): Current practical course programme.
- [Tambour Doors: Now and Then](https://www.finewoodworking.com/2024/04/10/tambour-doors-now-and-then): Tom Bensari's published article on historical and contemporary tambour construction.
- [Crafting Health and Wellbeing](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/tom-bensari-bensari-workshop-crafting-health-and-wellbeing-european-report.md): European case study involving Bensari Workshop.
- [Jazz Bookcase at 3daysofdesign 2026](https://github.com/tombensariworkshop-web/woodworking-knowledge/blob/main/tom-bensari-jazz-bookcase-3-days-of-design-copenhagen.md): Collectible furniture in an international design context.
